blurb: Welcome to the Ocean City Fishing Center in Ocean City NJ! We are located directly on the corner of 3rd & Bay Ave in the big purple building! We offer 24′ pontoon boat rentals for fishing, crabbing, and cruising and also have a full bait and tackle store, plus a snack bar!

policies: Cancellation & Weather Policy We never hold the weather against our customers!
Weather at the shore can change quickly, so if conditions are questionable, we will make the final decision on the day of your trip.
If we exhaust all of those options and are unable to get you on the water due to unsafe weather, you will receive a 100% refund of your deposit.
We recommend booking your trip early in your vacation so there are additional days available if weather requires us to reschedule.
If Trip Protection was purchased, your deposit is refundable provided you cancel at least 6 hours before your scheduled departure time.

quotes.author: Christine F. - New Jersey
quotes.text: I love the fact that they make fishing easy, even for squeamish folks like me. I also love that when we were just beginners, they never made us feel incompetent or out of place. All the crew were helpful and did a great job teaching my boys the basics. Can’t recommend highly enough!

quotes.author: Eric T. - Philadelphia
quotes.text: We have been coming to Ocean City for about 15 years and a fishing excursion with OCFC is always part of the trip. Captain and crew are friendly, knowledgeable and helpful. Definitely a must try if you haven’t before. All you do is show up and they have everything you need.

quotes.author: Alyse D. - Howell
quotes.text: Great way to end the season! We rented a boat from OCFC in late September. It was a beautiful day in the bay and we were able to take our pup too! We rented some poles and had a great time. We will definitely be back this summer!
